learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to draw our favorite vehicles and exciting journeys using simple shapes like circles and rectangles!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Every car, bus, and train needs wheels! We can draw perfect wheels using circles. Inside the big circle, draw a smaller circle to make it look real.
Aeroplanes and helicopters fly high in the sky. We can use long ovals for the body of a plane and triangles for its cool wings!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Dream Car
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a car that runs on rainbow power! Give it bright colors, giant wheels, and maybe even a pair of wings.

quick_recap: ⭐ Vehicles are made of simple shapes like rectangles for buses and circles for wheels.
⭐ We can draw different paths like roads, train tracks, or fluffy clouds.
⭐ Drawing vehicles taking us on magical journeys is super fun!
